title: Kinkou Initiate's play trigger draws unconditionally; the 'if your other units have total Might 5 or more' condition is not checked.
expected: Card def (packages/riftbound-cards/src/cards/unl/kinkou-initiate.ts) has no hand-authored abilities, so enrich-cards.ts:30 parses rulesText. Verified via bun: parser emits a triggered play-self ability with effect {type:"draw",amount:1} and ability-level condition {type:"total-might-at-least",amount:5,scope:"other-units"} (condition-parser.ts:782-791). The engine never evaluates that condition type: `grep -r total-might-at-least` hits only the parser; evaluateTriggerCondition in packages/riftbound-engine/src/abilities/trigger-runner.ts:289-521 has no branch for it and falls through to `return true` at trigger-runner.ts:520 ("Unknown condition shapes are permissive"). So the trigger always goes on the chain as a bare draw 1 regardless of other-unit total Might, matching the observed unconditional draw.
observed: Trigger went on chain as {"amount":1,"type":"draw"} (no condition) and on resolution drew 1 (hand 5->6 'Void Hatchling', p1 deck 35->34).
